title: Shifted binomial sum limit
statement: For natural numbers $c$ and $k$ with $k\le c+1$, and each natural number $m$, set $p_{m,c,j}=\binom{2m+c}{m+j}/2^{2m+c}$ and $a_m=\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$. As $m$ tends to infinity, $\sum_{j=0}^{k-1} p_{m,c,j}/a_m$ tends to $k$.
